decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already fully captures the required one-ticket and one-$5-commission accounting in NFT attributes for both coded and no-code mints.
The current mechanism already issues one ticket for a coded referral and assigns one ticket randomly when no referral code is used; the source does not change the prize mechanism.
The source addresses leaderboard and NFT-attribute accounting, not About-page copy, which already describes random no-code reward assignment consistently.
The reference to 12 completed mints establishes the expected leaderboard reward totals, not a change to the public platform-statistics requirement.
The source concerns reward accounting on leaderboards and NFT attributes and does not change which NFTs must appear in the dashboard ownership listing.
The source explicitly targets leaderboard and NFT metadata attributes; it does not necessarily change the separate NFT detail-view summary requirement.
The source requires no-code rewards to appear on the leaderboard and in NFT attributes, not on the dashboard; the dashboard's random-commission display rule remains unchanged.
The source changes reward-accounting accuracy for coded and no-code mints but does not alter how fiat buyers access wallets, dashboards, commissions, tickets, or prizes.
The source does not request a FAQ revision, and the approved FAQ state already includes one ticket per referral and random no-code reward assignment.
Leaderboard and NFT-attribute reward accounting does not change the certificate email, its contents, or its read action.
The source concerns reward issuance and display after mints and does not change how books, referral codes, badges, or ticket state transfer with an NFT.
The source confirms that coded referral commissions are already accurately reflected and does not change their amount, trigger, recipient, timing, or delivery.
